The '''2022–23 Czech First League''', known as the '''[[Czech First League|FORTUNA:LIGA]]''' for sponsorship reason, is the 30th season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[association football|football]] for professional clubs since its 1993 establishment. [[FC Viktoria Plzeň]] are the reigning champions. The season started on 30 July 2022. The first half of the season will have 16 rounds, finishing on 13 November 2022 because of the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]], and the other half will commence on 28 January 2023. The season is expected to end on 28 May 2023 with two extra play-out fixtures on 1 and 4 June 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=Los fotbalové ligy: Plzeň i Slavia začnou venku, Sparta doma proti Liberci|url=https://www.idnes.cz/fotbal/prvni-liga/los-fortuna-liga-rocnik-2022-2023.A220622_123036_fotbal_min|publisher=iDnes|language=cs|date=2022-06-22}}</ref>

The season format is unchanged from last season, 16 clubs play each other home and away, until the league is split up in championship, play-off and relegation groups. The lowest-ranked team was relegated directly to the second league, the two teams positioned 14th and 15th played a play-out with two teams from the second league positioned 2nd and 3rd in a home and away format. This was the fifth season to use [[Video assistant referee|VAR]], featuring it in all matches played. The year-to-year changes in the format of the competition are only cosmetic, the most significant change being the increase of the number of [[Substitute (association football)|substitutes]] permitted on the substitute bench to 11.<ref>{{cite web |title=Šádek a spol. mají u laviček utrum. V lize až 11 náhradníků, kalibrovaná čára ne|url=https://www.idnes.cz/fotbal/prvni-liga/fortuna-liga-rocnik-2022-23.A220622_163828_fotbal_jic|publisher=iDnes|language=cs|date=2022-06-22}}</ref>

===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)===
A total of sixteen teams contested the league, including fifteen sides from the 2021–22 season and the winner of last season's second league.

;Team promoted to Czech First League
After being relegated in the [[2020–21 Czech First League|2020–21]] season, [[FC Zbrojovka Brno|Zbrojovka Brno]] returned to Czech First League as the champion of the [[2021–22 Czech National Football League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Zbrojovka Brno se vrací do první fotbalové ligy, jistotu postupu jí zajistila remíza Vlašimi|url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/sport/fotbal/fotbal-druha-liga-zbrojovka-brno-postup-vyskov-vlasim_2204271926_bac|publisher=[[Czech Radio]]|language=cs|date=2022-04-27}}</ref>

;Teams relegated from Czech First League
The lowest positioned team from the [[2021–22 Czech First League|last season]], [[MFK Karviná]], was relegated to the Czech National Football League. The 14th-placed [[Bohemians 1905]] and 15th-placed [[FK Teplice]] successfully defended their spots in the first league by winning the [[2021–22 Czech First League#Relegation play-offs|relegation play-offs]].

==Relegation play-offs==
Teams placed 14th and 15th in the relegation group faced the teams placed 2nd and 3rd in the [[2022–23 Czech National Football League|Czech National Football League]] for two spots in the next season.

{{end}}
